rationale: The workflow runs 8 matrix configurations (3 OS × multiple build types) that each fetch Conan C++ dependencies. Evidence pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE reports modest but measurable VM time reduction (6% free, 3.4% paid) from caching dependency downloads when repeated fetching is measurable and cache inputs include lockfile and environment. The workflow uses Conan 1.x (per resources/build/requirements.txt) with a local .conan directory in the workspace and likely a global ~/.conan cache. Adding actions/cache@v4 for both paths, keyed by OS and conanfile/conan.lock hashes, preserves all required build and test coverage while avoiding repeated dependency downloads across matrix jobs. No contraindications apply: Conan packages are immutable per configuration, and no equivalent cache exists in the current workflow.
